scenarios.prompt: Compute the 3-factor DuPont decomposition. Net income $145M, revenue $2,200M, total assets $1,850M, total equity $720M. Report ROE (as decimal, e.g. 0.2014), net_margin, asset_turnover, equity_multiplier.

Same firm: net income $145M, revenue $2,200M, total assets $1,850M, total equity $720M. Additional data: EBT (earnings before tax) = $195M, EBIT (earnings before interest and tax) = $240M. Since EBT and EBIT are provided, the appropriate decomposition is the 5-factor DuPont (Tax Burden × Interest Burden × EBIT Margin × Asset Turnover × Equity Multiplier), NOT the 3-factor. Compute ROE and the 5 components: tax_burden, interest_burden, ebit_margin, asset_turnover, equity_multiplier.
